transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thanks. Well, I'm here because I just feel like I'm always running hot. It's like I can't shut the motor off, no matter what I do. And lately, that's been getting me in trouble at the firehouse, so I figured I needed to come in and talk to someone.
Has this feeling of being driven by a motor been present since you were a child?

Yeah, it has. Actually, my mom says I was like this back in grade school, too. I guess I was always getting out of my seat or just... blurting out answers before the teacher even finished asking. And I was always losing my homework. I got a lot of notes sent home about it back then, even though the teachers said I was bright enough to do the work. It's just always been like this.
